items.title: Members of Congress urge court to reject DOJ's support for OpenAI in New York Times copyright case
items.summary: Representatives Jerrold Nadler, Jamie Raskin and Johnson urged the court on 30 October to reject the Justice Department's argument that AI training on copyrighted journalism is lawful. DOJ filed a statement of interest in September in the OpenAI cases in the Southern District of New York, arguing LLM training is fair use and that obstacles to AI development threaten national security.
items.why_it_matters: Could decide whether AI firms must pay for training data; Congress and the administration are on opposite sides.

items.title: Trump ties robotics imports to national security after Commerce finding
items.summary: The president issued a proclamation backing the Commerce Department's national-security finding on imports of robotics and industrial machinery and called for negotiations. Based only on a short summary.
items.why_it_matters: Possible tariffs on robotics could affect Norwegian industrial buyers.
